answer: Deferred operator liability ledger. Each new identity registers free, but its first payout is held until the operator’s account passes a review window; every identity an operator creates shares one reputation record, so a fake account’s fraud demotes all its siblings at once. The cost is a delayed echo of revenue across the operator’s whole fleet, plus a bridge that blocks cross-operator transfers until the hold clears. At each dawn, unreviewed identities roll the hold forward 24 hours.
